class.name: OcgGCMakearcofparabola2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for arcs of parabolas in the plane. The result is a `Geom2d_TrimmedCurve`. A `GC_MakeArcOfParabola2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and the resulting arc via `Value()`.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for arcs of parabolas in the plane. ! The result is a `Geom2d_TrimmedCurve`. ! A `GC_MakeArcOfParabola2d` object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction parameters; ! - running the construction algorithm; ! - querying the construction status and the resulting arc via `Value()`. ! @note Angular parameters are expressed in radians.
